ios.desc:
Browse securely online with HTTPS4All. This app has an extensive database of sites that support secure connections, and will automatically redirect you to the secure version when you access those sites.

The database is derived from the HTTPS Everywhere project from the EFF.

quotes.text:
I've written a janky Ruby script that automatically tries to convert the HTTPS Everywhere rules into content blockers: https://github.com/bouk/https-everywhere-host-list/blob/master/generate.rb

It's used to create the host list for HTTP4All, my unofficial port of HTTPS Everywhere to iOS https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/https4all/id1305430042?mt=8
quotes.story_title: A more efficient matching engine for HTTPS Everywhere
